name: Competitive Intelligence Plugin
description: Bundle competitor signal collection, evidence review, and insight packaging into a reusable plugin for marketing strategy teams.

limitations: External claims remain human-reviewed; the packaged Markdown hook is advisory on runtimes without a native enforcement mapping.
usability.quickstart: Run `node scripts/first_use.mjs examples/first-use-input.json` after installation to produce an evidence-labelled signal digest.

limitations: Requires a declared Node.js 22 execution capability; it never authorizes publication.

authentication.credential_storage: No credentials are used by this instruction bundle.
authentication.validation: Confirm no authentication challenge is introduced by runtime wiring.
authentication.revocation: Not applicable; remove the installed bundle to withdraw it.
